test_container_task_id_resolution: test that _resolve_container_task_id maps None and empty strings to the default shared container
test_subagent_id_collapse: test that subagent task IDs like subagent-0-deadbeef collapse to the default shared container
test_register_task_env_overrides: register environment overrides for a task_id so it gets its own isolated sandbox instead of the default
test_clear_task_env_overrides: clear previously registered environment overrides so the task_id collapses back to the default container
test_get_active_env_lookup: test that get_active_env resolves subagent task IDs to the shared default environment using _resolve_container_task_id
